title: mail: per-user Mailbox subscriptions
description:
Implement subscription management: (1) add isSubscribed field to Mailbox type (default false unless row in subscriptions table); (2) implement Mailbox/set update to toggle isSubscribed (inserts/deletes from subscriptions table); (3) surface subscription status in Mailbox/get and Mailbox/query.

Why: JMAP clients (e.g., iOS Mail, Fastmail) display only subscribed folders; without subscription support, all groups always appear.

Acceptance: subscribe to a group via Mailbox/set update, then Mailbox/query with isSubscribed=true returns that group.
